data.name: Johnny Chainsaw
data.detailed_description:
Johnny Chainsaw is a single player puzzle platformer where players don’t have a jump button. Immerse yourself in this world of power structures, ethical dilemmas, and struggles in responding to change.

No Jump Button

Use the world to navigate obstacles and levels. How can you use the world to cross this gap without a jump button?

Two Modes

  • Story mode: A discovery at the center of the planet, a response hampered by power struggles, and the inevitable change that threatens the world. You decide what happens to the inhabitants of Corut and how their lives will be forever changed.
  • Standard mode: Complete the game without story mode elements. Perfect for streaming, speedrunning, or enjoying weird platforming mechanics without narrative screens interrupting game flow.

Gameplay Features

  • 40 short levels
  • 6 boss fights
  • Death counter and timer
  • Collectables
  • Character Sheets
  • Rich story and Custscenes (story mode only)
  • Quick resets after character death - get right back in the action
  • Achievements

Decide the Fate of the World (Story Mode Only)


When Yarbor's lead researcher Ivan discovers a change at the planet's core, a power struggle ensues at the company. This conflict forever changes the lives of all mechanics and organics on Corut.
  • Reveal Ivan's discovery
  • Explore the power struggle and its ramifications
  • Recognize your part in the this conflict
  • Resolve the conflict and change life on Corut forever

reviews.review:
[h2]Johnny Chainsaw[/h2]

[h1]Sadly Not Chainsaw Man[/h1]

Johnny Chainsaw is a single-player puzzle platformer that brings a unique twist to the genre by removing the jump button. In this game, players must utilize the world itself to navigate through obstacles and levels, offering a fresh and challenging gameplay experience. Beyond its gameplay mechanics, Johnny Chainsaw also boasts a rich storyline that delves into power structures, ethical dilemmas, and the inevitable consequences of change.

[h1]About This Game [/h1]

[h2]Storyline [/h2]

Johnny Chainsaw's story mode introduces players to a fascinating narrative that revolves around a monumental discovery at the center of the planet. As players progress, they become entangled in a power struggle that hampers the response to this discovery, leaving the fate of the world hanging in the balance. The game explores themes of power, consequences, and the impact of change on the inhabitants of Corut. Through rich storytelling and cutscenes, players uncover Ivan's discovery, witness the power struggle, and realize their role in resolving the conflict that will forever alter life on Corut.

[h2]Gameplay Mechanics[/h2]

The absence of a jump button in Johnny Chainsaw forces players to think creatively and utilize the environment to overcome obstacles. Each level presents puzzles and challenges that require strategic use of the world's elements. Whether it's finding alternative paths, leveraging momentum, or exploiting the terrain, players must adapt and explore new ways to progress. The game offers 40 short levels and 6 boss fights, providing a variety of gameplay experiences. Additionally, a death counter and timer add an extra layer of challenge and competition for those interested in speedrunning or pushing their skills to the limit. 

[b]Note:[/b] If you absolutely hate “Trial-&-Error” gameplay, this game is full of it. So yes, steer away from this title.

[h2]Visuals and Sound[/h2]

The visuals showcase unique and imaginative environments that complement the game's mechanics and story. Coupled with a fitting audio design, the game aims to create a captivating atmosphere that enhances the player's engagement and immersion.

Just know that I am not a big fan of this game’s art style since they tried to add emission wherever they could. The glowing effect is pretty cool but it gets annoying when it’s overused. Several assets feel out of place. There is no uniformity in the game’s visuals. It’s just chaotic. I am sure the designers could whip out better outputs if they were given a particular art style to follow. 

[h1]Pros[/h1]
[list]
[*] The absence of a jump button in Johnny Chainsaw forces players to think creatively and use the environment in innovative ways. This adds a refreshing challenge and keeps the gameplay engaging and exciting.
[*] With 40 short levels and 6 boss fights, Johnny Chainsaw offers a variety of puzzles and challenges that will test your problem-solving skills and dexterity. Overcoming each obstacle without a jump button requires careful planning and precise execution.
[*] For players who enjoy narrative depth in their games, the story mode of Johnny Chainsaw delivers a compelling tale of power struggles and the consequences of change. The game explores thought-provoking themes, adding emotional resonance to the overall experience.
[*] Whether you prefer diving into the immersive story mode or simply want to enjoy the platforming mechanics without interruptions, Johnny Chainsaw offers a standard mode that allows you to complete the game without story elements. This flexibility caters to different player preferences.
[*] With collectibles, achievements, and the option for speedrunning, Johnny Chainsaw provides replay value for those seeking to fully explore and master the game. The death counter and timer add an extra layer of challenge for competitive players.
[/list]

[h1]Cons[/h1]
[list]
[*] While the unique mechanics of Johnny Chainsaw offer an engaging experience, some players may find that the absence of a jump button restricts the range of movement and platforming options available. This could potentially lead to a feeling of repetitiveness over extended play sessions.
[*] Although the story mode offers a rich narrative, the impact of player decisions on the outcome of the game may feel limited. Players may desire more agency and consequences in shaping the story based on their choices.
[*] There is no consistency in the game’s visuals. It just feels like random stuff thrown together. They also overuse the glowing effect on objects. It gets annoying to look at after a while.
[*] With 40 short levels, some players might find Johnny Chainsaw's overall gameplay length relatively brief. This could leave players craving for more content or a longer-lasting experience.
[*] The absence of a jump button and the need to rely on unconventional mechanics might initially disorient players, especially those accustomed to traditional platformers. While it can be rewarding once mastered, the learning curve may pose a challenge for some players to fully enjoy the game.
[/list]

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

Johnny Chainsaw presents an intriguing concept by removing the jump button from a puzzle platformer, challenging players to think differently and use the environment in clever ways. The game offers a compelling storyline with elements of power struggles and the consequences of change. If you're seeking a platformer that breaks conventions and offers a blend of inventive gameplay and thought-provoking storytelling, Johnny Chainsaw is definitely worth playing. The game isn’t even that expensive, the developers made sure that you don’t go broke while trying to play this game!

[b]Reviewer:[/b] Midplayz
